title: Austin Housing, DNA Lab, & City Contracts
summary:
*   **Major Housing Plan Unveiled:** City received a briefing on the Austin Strategic Housing Plan, aiming to create 60,000 affordable housing units over 10 years, addressing displacement and equitable distribution, with a public hearing scheduled.
*   **DNA Lab & Sexual Assault Kit Backlog Addressed:** Approved actions to rectify past failures at the city's DNA lab and speed up the processing of thousands of sexual assault evidence kits, enhancing justice and public safety.
*   **Flood Buyouts Delayed for Equity:** Funding for flood-damaged property buyouts in Onion Creek was postponed to ensure a fair and comprehensive plan for all affected residents, following emotional public testimonies.
*   **City Contracts & Lobbying Rules Under Review:** A new committee will scrutinize city waste management contracts and anti-lobbying rules to boost transparency and competition in public bidding processes.
*   **Plaza Saltillo Affordable Housing Protections:** Amended development plans for Plaza Saltillo to mandate on-site affordable housing if the project's use ever shifts from commercial to residential.

agenda_items.description: Approve a resolution directing the City Manager to evaluate and explore the options available for repurposing the properties at 1215 Red River Street and 606 East 12th Street, which were previously occupied by HealthSouth.
Approve a resolution directing the City Manager to take steps to support cooperatively owned businesses.

Posting Language:   Approve a resolution to support and promote women's equality.  Council requests that the Commission for Women and the Human Rights Commission jointly submit any recommendations developed pursuant to this resolution to the Council within 180 days from the date of the resolution.    *Public Works - please review the resolution and work with HRD on the request made within the resolution to "study disparities in Austin between streets named after men and those named after women, and take appropriate measures to eliminate those disparities"    **The staff liaisons for the 2 commissions named within the Resolution have been made aware of the resolution and the request**
Approve a resolution establishing a council working group to examine and provide recommendations on Austin Resource Recovery and Austin Water organics and recycling policies and contracts.
